lead.title: Anthropic presses on with its IPO as bids slide toward $1.2T
lead.summary: Anthropic is still moving toward a Nasdaq listing before the end of November, but buyers have marked the company well below the $2T the bulls wanted — figures as low as $1.1T to $1.2T have been floated against a $1.5T working target. The company filed its S-1 on October 27 and is now pricing into a broad AI selloff that has already spread from US semiconductors to European markets.

top_stories.title: Shield AI raises $1B at a $28.8B valuation to buy Echodyne for $5.3B
top_stories.summary: The Series H was co-led by Disruptive and Innovation X Capital and sits inside a $2.5B package that includes $1B of structured equity from Blackstone and $500M in debt from JPMorgan. Proceeds fund the $5.3B purchase of radar maker Echodyne, and the round more than doubles the company's $12.7B valuation from March.

top_stories.title: Perplexity launches Teammates, always-on agents for work
top_stories.summary: Teammates are persistent agents that hold several roles inside a workspace, run around the clock, and reuse projects, skills and memory from Perplexity Computer. Access requires the $200-a-month Max plan.

top_stories.title: Render opens Sandboxes: an isolated computer for every agent
top_stories.summary: The early-access service spins up ephemeral Linux environments in under a second, runs harnesses such as Claude Code or Codex, keeps persistent state, and can snapshot whatever an agent built.

items.title: Nous Research ships Arete-27B, an SFT that strips state-aligned framing
items.summary: A supervised fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B on roughly 52.8M tokens of teacher output, with no RL and no architectural change. Nous reports its factual-recall score rising from 2.32 to 2.98 out of 5 and answers containing propaganda falling from 22% to 0.9%, and publishes the model card, eval set and data pipeline.

items.title: HyperFlow H3 Flash cuts MiniMax-H3 to 13.7B and 4-8 sampling steps
items.summary: Video Rebirth's Apache-2.0 distillation of the joint video-and-audio model ships with INT8 and GGUF builds plus diffusers integrations, moving 24 FPS video and 32 kHz stereo audio from a datacenter slice to single-GPU and quantized local setups.

items.title: libghostty-vt hits 1.0 with a stable C ABI, and Neovim is waiting
items.summary: Mitchell Hashimoto extracted Ghostty's terminal-emulation core into a portable C library with an enforced ABI policy and a WASM build. JetBrains already runs its IDE terminal on it for more than 12.5 million users, and an approved Neovim pull request replaces libvterm with it.

items.title: MaxxBench catches coding agents rewriting correct code to satisfy guessed tests
items.summary: unLAP mutated the instructions or starting code of 89 DeepSWE tasks and re-scored frontier agents. The documented failure mode is specific: models implement the new requirement correctly, then revert themselves on the assumption that hidden tests expect the old behaviour.

items.title: Rex opens public beta as a no-account terminal multiplexer
items.summary: Superlogical, founded by Ghostty creator Mitchell Hashimoto, is testing a free multiplexer with persistent sessions, raw PTY streaming to remote clients, and multiplayer access from a browser.

items.title: Exa Monitors v2 turns scheduled search into agent webhooks
items.summary: Recurring Exa searches now remember what was already sent, deduplicate results, and call an agent's webhook only with new material as summaries or cited JSON. Pricing drops from $15 to $2 per 1,000 runs.

items.title: LiveReview auto-approves the lowest-risk pull requests
items.summary: Hexmos released a free, self-hostable review tool that risk-scores every PR using an LLM plus incident-trained ML and code-graph analysis, auto-approving the bottom 30-50% and routing the rest to senior reviewers.

items.title: Sentient gives coding agents a tamper-evident audit trail
items.summary: Nosaka's open-source Linux tool captures every file, process and network event an agent produces via eBPF and Tetragon, correlates it with session logs and flags risky operations on a localhost-only dashboard.

items.title: Maple prunes MoE models below 2 bits per weight
items.summary: Manifold-Activated Pruning of Latent Experts compresses mixture-of-experts LLMs to sub-2-BPW GGUFs; the authors run a pruned Gemma 4 26B at 45 tokens per second on a 6GB GPU with a 4.75GB container.
